description: Reminder to a student listing the assignments, assessments and online exams they have not yet submitted, each with its due date. Sent from the student record's View Grades window.
subject: Outstanding work reminder — $item_count item(s) not yet submitted
body:
Dear $first_name,

Our records show the following work has not been submitted yet. Please check each item and submit before its deadline.

Outstanding items ($item_count)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
$outstanding_items
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you have already submitted something on this list, it may not have been recorded — contact your module leader so it can be checked.

If you are having difficulty meeting a deadline, speak to your module leader or personal tutor as early as you can. Extensions and mitigating circumstances have to be arranged before the deadline passes wherever possible.

Student ID: $student_id
Generated: $generated_at

Kind regards,
$sender_name
University Academic Office

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated reminder. Please do not reply to this email.
